about.title: About VA Loan Calculator - Veterans Home Financing Tool
about.description: The VA Loan Calculator is a specialized home financing tool designed to help eligible veterans, active-duty service members, and surviving spouses calculate monthly payments and benefits for VA-backed home loans. VA loans offer unique advantages including no down payment requirements, no private mortgage insurance (PMI), and competitive interest rates. This calculator helps you understand your VA loan benefits, calculate monthly payments, and compare VA loans with conventional financing options.

howTo.title: How to Use the VA Loan Calculator

steps.title: Home Price
steps.description: Enter the purchase price of the home you're considering buying.

steps.title: Down Payment
steps.description: Input your down payment amount (VA loans allow 0% down payment for eligible borrowers).

steps.title: Interest Rate
steps.description: Enter the VA loan interest rate offered by your lender.

steps.title: Loan Term
steps.description: Select the loan term (typically 15 or 30 years for VA loans).

steps.title: VA Funding Fee
steps.description: Include the VA funding fee (varies by service type, down payment, and first-time use).

steps.title: Review Benefits
steps.description: Compare VA loan advantages with conventional loan requirements and costs.

faq.q: Who is eligible for VA loans?
faq.a: VA loans are available to veterans who served 90+ days during wartime or 181+ days during peacetime, current active-duty members after 90 days of service, National Guard/Reserve members with 6+ years of service, and surviving spouses of service members who died in service or from service-connected disabilities.

faq.q: What is the VA funding fee and can it be waived?
faq.a: The VA funding fee ranges from 1.4% to 3.6% of the loan amount, depending on service type, down payment, and first-time use. Veterans with service-connected disabilities rated at 10% or higher are exempt from the funding fee.

faq.q: Can I use a VA loan more than once?
faq.a: Yes, VA loan benefits can be used multiple times. You can reuse your entitlement after paying off a previous VA loan, or use remaining entitlement for additional properties if you have sufficient entitlement available.

As of 2020, there are no VA loan limits for eligible veterans with full entitlement. However, if you've used your entitlement before or have reduced entitlement, limits may apply based on conforming loan limits in your county.
